---
title: Risotto with White Cuttlefish
id: MAR-0104
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 60
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 300 g of cuttlefish
- 280 g of rice
- 1 tablespoon of parsley
- 2 garlic cloves
- 9 dl of fish stock
- 1 dl of white wine
- 10 g of butter
- 2 tablespoons of extra virgin olive oil
## Method
1. Cut the cuttlefish into thick strips.
2. Heat the oil in a pan, add the peeled garlic, let it wilt for 4 minutes and remove it.
3. Add the cuttlefish and let them flavor for 3-4 minutes; raise the heat, pour in the wine and let it boil, then adjust the heat and cook for 40 minutes.
4. In a saucepan, melt the butter and toast the rice for one minute.
5. Pour the boiling broth one ladle at a time, so that the liquid just covers the surface of the rice, and cook until done.
6. Add the cuttlefish and the parsley, mix and serve.
